Projects.Machine-Learning-Project.txt:
Machine Learning Image Classifier
==================================

Description:
A convolutional neural network for classifying images with high accuracy.

Technologies:
- Python
- TensorFlow/Keras
- NumPy, Pandas
- Jupyter Notebooks

Features:
- Custom CNN architecture
- Data augmentation pipeline
- Transfer learning with pre-trained models
- Web interface for real-time predictions

Results:
- Achieved 94% accuracy on test set
- Reduced inference time by 40% through optimization
- Deployed as REST API for production use

Dataset:
- 50,000 training images
- 10,000 validation images
- 10 different classes

GitHub: github.com/arminrez/ml-image-classifier

Projects.Terminal-Portfolio.txt:
Terminal Portfolio Website
==========================

Description:
An interactive terminal-based portfolio website that simulates a Unix-like command-line interface.

Technologies:
- Vanilla JavaScript
- HTML5/CSS3
- JSON for data storage
- Python for file system generation

Features:
- Modular filesystem loaded from JSON
- Unix-like commands (ls, cd, pwd, cat, tree)
- Tab completion and command history
- Hidden files support
- Responsive terminal design

Why This Approach:
- Unique and memorable user experience
- Demonstrates technical skills in an interactive way
- Easy to update content via filesystem regeneration
- Appeals to technical recruiters and developers

You're using it right now! 😊
